name: wallrush
description: WallRush — a fast, beautiful, free multiplayer Quoridor game for the web

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wallrush/shared && npm run build -w @wallrush/client && npm run build -w @wallrush/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wallrush/shared && npm run test -w @wallrush/server && npm run test -w @wallrush/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @wallrush/client
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w @wallrush/shared && VITE_API_BASE=https://wallrush.duckdns.org npm run build -w @wallrush/client && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
